title: 极睿视频 MCP 连接配置
description: 请输入在极睿视频中为本次连接创建、专用于 WorkBuddy 的 MCP Token。凭证仅保存在本机 WorkBuddy 配置目录中，不会随 Connector 上架包分发；不得在其他 MCP 客户端复用。
description_en: Enter a dedicated MCP Token created in Infimind Video for this WorkBuddy connection. It is stored only in the local WorkBuddy configuration, never bundled with this Connector. Do not reuse it in another MCP client.
docLabel: 前往极睿视频创建 Token
docLabel_en: Create a Token in Infimind Video

fields.label: MCP Token
fields.placeholder: 粘贴仅显示一次的 MCP Token
fields.placeholder_en: Paste the MCP Token shown once after creation
fields.description: 用于访问你本人的极睿视频账户、本人积分和任务。请勿分享；不再使用或疑似泄露时，请立即在 Token 管理页撤销。
fields.description_en: Used to access your own Infimind Video account, your credits, and tasks. Do not share it; revoke it from the Token management page when no longer needed or if exposure is suspected.
